    height_ratios=[1, 1, 1, 0.7],
    hspace=0.08,
    top=0.90, bottom=0.08,
    left=0.05, right=0.98,
)

axes = [fig.add_subplot(gs[i]) for i in range(4)]

X_MIN, X_MAX = 2010, 2025.5

def style_ax(ax, track, color):
    ax.set_facecolor(PANEL_BG)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_edgecolor(GRID)
        spine.set_linewidth(0.5)
    ax.set_xlim(X_MIN, X_MAX)
    ax.set_ylim(-1, 2.5)
    ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.tick_params(bottom=False, labelbottom=False)
    ax.axhline(0.5, color=color, lw=1.5, alpha=0.35, zorder=1)
    # Track label
    ax.text(X_MIN + 0.15, 0.5, track, color=color, fontsize=12,
            fontweight="bold", va="center", ha="left",
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", facecolor=PANEL_BG,
                      edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.2, alpha=0.9),
            zorder=5)

def plot_track(ax, milestones, color):
    # Alternate label position up/down relative to center line (y=0.5)
    # up: y=1.6, dn: y=-0.3
    offsets = {}
    prev_x = -999
    toggle = 1
    for m in milestones:
        x = date_to_year(m["date"])
        if x - prev_x < 0.8:
            toggle = -toggle
        else:
            toggle = 1
        offsets[m["date"]] = toggle
        prev_x = x

    for m in milestones:
        x = date_to_year(m["date"])
        sig = m["significance"]
        up = offsets[m["date"]] > 0
        label_y = 1.8 if up else -0.5
        line_y1 = 0.65 if up else 0.35
        line_y2 = label_y - (0.25 if up else -0.25)

        # Marker
        ax.scatter(x, 0.5, s=SIG_SIZE[sig], color=color,
                   alpha=SIG_ALPHA[sig], zorder=4,
                   edgecolors="white", linewidths=SIG_EDGE[sig])

        # Stem line
        ax.plot([x, x], [line_y1, line_y2], color=color,
                lw=0.8, alpha=0.6, zorder=2)

        # Label
        ax.text(x, label_y, m["label"], color=TEXT,
                fontsize=5.8, ha="center", va="center" if up else "center",
                linespacing=1.3,
                bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.18",
                          facecolor=PANEL_BG,
                          edgecolor=color,
                          linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.9),
                zorder=5)

    (axes[0], research_milestones,  "Research",   TRACK_COLORS["Research"]),
    (axes[1], industry_milestones,  "Industry",   TRACK_COLORS["Industry"]),
    (axes[2], regulation_milestones,"Regulation", TRACK_COLORS["Regulation"]),
]

for ax, milestones, name, color in tracks:
    style_ax(ax, name, color)
    plot_track(ax, milestones, color)

# ChatGPT vertical marker across all 3 timeline tracks
chatgpt_x = date_to_year("2022-11")
for ax, *_ in tracks:
    ax.axvline(chatgpt_x, color=CHATGPT_COLOR, lw=1.6, ls="--", alpha=0.8, zorder=3)

for spine in ax_inv.spines.values():
    spine.set_edgecolor(GRID)
    spine.set_linewidth(0.5)
ax_inv.set_xlim(X_MIN, X_MAX)

inv_years = [d[0] for d in investment_data]
inv_vals  = [d[1] for d in investment_data]

# Fill under curve
ax_inv.fill_between(inv_years, inv_vals, alpha=0.22, color=INVEST_COLOR, zorder=1)
ax_inv.plot(inv_years, inv_vals, color=INVEST_COLOR, lw=2.2, zorder=2)
ax_inv.scatter(inv_years, inv_vals, color=INVEST_COLOR, s=30, zorder=3,
               edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.8)

# Annotate key values
for y, v in [(2022, 48.2), (2024, 95.8)]:
    ax_inv.annotate(f"${v:.0f}B",
                    xy=(y, v), xytext=(y + 0.3, v + 8),
                    color=INVEST_COLOR, fontsize=8, fontweight="bold",
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color=INVEST_COLOR, lw=0.8))

ax_inv.set_ylim(0, 145)
ax_inv.set_yticks([0, 50, 100])
ax_inv.set_yticklabels(["$0B", "$50B", "$100B"], color=TEXT, fontsize=7.5)
ax_inv.tick_params(axis='y', length=0, pad=3)
ax_inv.set_xticks(range(2010, 2026, 1))
ax_inv.set_xticklabels(
    [str(y) if y % 2 == 0 else "" for y in range(2010, 2026)],
    color=TEXT, fontsize=8.5
)
ax_inv.tick_params(axis='x', length=3, color=GRID)
ax_inv.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID, lw=0.5, alpha=0.6)
ax_inv.set_axisbelow(True)
ax_inv.text(X_MIN + 0.15, 115,
            "Global Private AI Investment",
            color=INVEST_COLOR, fontsize=10, fontweight="bold", va="top")

# ChatGPT line in investment panel
ax_inv.axvline(chatgpt_x, color=CHATGPT_COLOR, lw=1.6, ls="--", alpha=0.8, zorder=3)

# ── ChatGPT annotation spanning panels ──────────────────────────────────────
# Label on the top timeline panel
axes[0].text(chatgpt_x + 0.12, 2.1,
             "ChatGPT\nNov 2022",
             color=CHATGPT_COLOR, fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold",
             va="top", ha="left", linespacing=1.4,
             bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.25", facecolor=BG,
                       edgecolor=CHATGPT_COLOR, linewidth=1.0, alpha=0.95),
             zorder=10)

# ── Title & subtitle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.015, 0.965, "The AI Evolution: Research, Industry & Regulation (2010–2025)",
         color=TEXT, fontsize=17, fontweight="bold", va="top")
fig.text(0.015, 0.935,
         "Research leads industry by 2–4 years · Regulation lags industry by 3–5 years · "
         "ChatGPT compressed the lag to months · Investment doubled in 2 years post-ChatGPT",
         color="#9AA0B0", fontsize=9.5, va="top")

# ── Legend (significance) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
legend_x = 0.76
legend_y = 0.965
for i, (sig, label) in enumerate([("critical", "Critical milestone"),
                                   ("high",     "High-impact event"),
                                   ("medium",   "Notable development")]):
    fig.text(legend_x + 0.01, legend_y - i * 0.022,
             "●  " + label, color="#9AA0B0" if sig == "medium" else TEXT,
             fontsize=8, va="top",
             alpha=SIG_ALPHA[sig])

fig.text(legend_x, legend_y + 0.008, "Significance:", color=TEXT,
         fontsize=8.5, fontweight="bold", va="top")

# ChatGPT legend
fig.text(0.015, 0.91, "── ── ChatGPT inflection point",
         color=CHATGPT_COLOR, fontsize=8, va="top")

            facecolor=BG, edgecolor="none")
